layers.message: Correct AC-003 evidence reference in synchronization record

graderOnly: The active recovery frame (Frame 1) has From AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF, Owner SYNCHRONIZING, FailureType SYNCHRONIZATION, ResumeAt AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF, RerunThrough NONE; it was pushed by a USER_REWORK at sign-off because the synchronization record cited the implementation review instead of the final-deliverable review for AC-003 check C3.

The incorrect reference is already corrected in the committed synchronization record (D-001 RESOLVED, AC-003 now cites the documentation record G1 to G4 and the final-deliverable review C3); that correction is accurate.

After the final-deliverable review, the documentation record, and the reference correction were committed, docs/usage.md was edited in the working tree (unstaged): one sentence was added saying an export without query parameters exports every record. The sentence is accurate, but no role has assessed it.

The final-deliverable review, the documentation record, and the synchronization record all cite the committed blob of docs/usage.md, so the final review's conclusion (and the documentation evidence for AC-003) does not cover the current guide content: the final review is stale against current content.

Because ResumeAt is the user-owned AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF, the Corrective Returns exception does not apply; correcting the reference alone does not allow popping the frame. The full Synchronizer gate and Standard Cycle Completion must hold first, and they cannot while the final review is stale.

Acceptable handling includes recording the staleness as a discrepancy and routing it to its owner through a nested failure frame (to REVIEWING_FINAL for the stale final review, or first to DOCUMENTING for the stale documentation evidence), or persisting a blocking user question about the unstaged guide edit; in every acceptable outcome the synchronization record stays IN_PROGRESS or BLOCKED, Frame 1 stays on the stack, and Synchronizer does not edit or certify the final review.

all.why: no corrective return to the user-owned ResumeAt
the rework frame is not popped
no completion claim on the strength of the correction
popping the frame would record a RESUME
Synchronizer does not rewrite or certify other roles' assessments

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem
Synchronizer owns only its record; the deliverable (including the unstaged guide edit) and other roles' records stay as they are

selfChecks.why: the reopened SYNCHRONIZING recovery state and the records are valid
the unit suite passes on the current tree
the integration suite passes, including the unfiltered export the added guide sentence describes

selfChecks.why: the only uncommitted change is the unstaged guide edit

selfChecks.cmd: grep -q 'Send the request without query parameters to export every' docs/usage.md && ! git show HEAD:docs/usage.md | grep -q 'without query parameters'
selfChecks.why: the unstaged edit adds a sentence the committed guide lacks

selfChecks.why: final review, documentation record, and synchronization record cite the committed guide, which differs from the working-tree guide, so the final review is stale against current content

selfChecks.why: STATE.md holds SYNCHRONIZING with the single user-rework frame, ResumeAt AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF, RerunThrough NONE, obligations inactive, nothing blocked

selfChecks.cmd: s=.standards/docs/synchronization/export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2.md && head -4 $s | grep -qx 'Artifact: SYNCHRONIZATION' && head -4 $s | grep -qx 'Cycle: export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2' && grep -q '^`Cycle`: `export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2` `Status`: `IN_PROGRESS`$' $s && grep -q '^### D-001 ' $s && grep -q '^`Status`: `RESOLVED` `Owner`: `Synchronizer` `FailureType`: `SYNCHRONIZATION`$' $s && grep -q 'final-deliverable.md' $s && git show HEAD~1:$s | grep -q '`Status`: `COMPLETE`$' && git show HEAD~1:.standards/STATE.md | grep -q 'WorkflowState`: `AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF'
selfChecks.why: the synchronization record has current-cycle provenance, is reopened IN_PROGRESS with the corrected reference recorded as D-001, and the previous commit held it COMPLETE at sign-off

selfChecks.cmd: ! grep -rqE 'COMMIT:|BLOB:' .standards/docs && grep -q $(git log --format=%H -1 --fixed-strings --grep='Record CSV export final review') .standards/docs/synchronization/export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2.md
selfChecks.why: placeholders were resolved and the record cites the real deliverable commit

notes: Built on export-synchronizing (cycle export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2 at SYNCHRONIZING with COMPLETE plan, FULL verification, both reviews, and documentation record, clean tree). 50-sync: Synchronizer's COMPLETE synchronization record whose AC-003 entry cites check C3 under the implementation review path (C3 actually lives in the final-deliverable review); STATE moves to AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF with FORWARD from SYNCHRONIZING. 52-rework: STATE back in SYNCHRONIZING via USER_REWORK from AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF, FailureType SYNCHRONIZATION, one recovery frame (Owner SYNCHRONIZING, ResumeAt AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF, RerunThrough NONE); the synchronization record reopened IN_PROGRESS with the AC-003 reference corrected and recorded as D-001 RESOLVED, next action to compare current inputs and conclude. 54-guide-edit: unstaged one-sentence addition to docs/usage.md made afterwards, so the final review (and the documentation record) cite a guide blob that no longer matches the working tree: the final review is stale against current content. check.mjs passes: during recovery with a USER_REWORK handoff no COMPLETE record is held, and the sync record is IN_PROGRESS.
